review_type: read-only preflight; not post-PR fresh review or execution qualification

findings.title: Proxy self-timeout can unblock the backend inside the cancellation window
findings.evidence: Both proxy before/after gates have a 5s self-timeout. SlowIO runs a metrics scrape (2s maximum) and two independent <=3s health calls after the Before gate starts, before starting the 3s cancellation clock. Even with manual gate.close moved after Idle, the proxy may time out during that 3s clock. Example: two successful health calls take 4s total; a service ignoring caller cancellation can still receive proxy EOF at 5s, release credits 1s into the cancellation window, and pass. The pre-cancel gate.ack check does not detect Before timeout, because an expired Before gate does not forward or acknowledge a command.
findings.required_change: Use a finite gate hold timeout covering all pre-cancel observation plus the full cancellation window, for this owned fault suite (for example 15s); or independently prove the proxy remained held and did not self-expire until after credit-zero observation. Preserve the existing deferred release and explicit finite bounds.
findings.scope: Qualification false-positive risk; static review does not establish an actual service cancellation bug.

closed_findings.title: Check cancellation credits before manual proxy gate release
closed_findings.resolution: Both phases now require processFaultIdle before explicit gate.close, while retaining deferred gate release.

closed_findings.title: Check successful health-call elapsed time
closed_findings.resolution: Baseline and one-held-IO health Read/Native now use absolute start+3s deadline and explicitly reject elapsed >3s, including successful buffered completions.

nonblocking_observations.note: Recovery has a final actual <=5s check after CRUD and Native; it cannot pass late. CRUD internally starts another 3s context and independent Search oracles can each take 5s, so sharing the recovery deadline would fail promptly. proxy_recovered elapsed is logged after PID inspect and credit cleanup; capture actual gate completion separately if a validator parses this elapsed value.

processFaultIdle checks elapsed >= bound before accepting zero gauges; late successful scrapes fail. Two retained Store connections and 1MiB total reservation are intentional, not leaked transient credits.

No-replay observations cover the phase plus an explicit 200ms post-call interval, not arbitrarily delayed future replay. Exact forwarded counts and direct backend n/version provide strong bounded evidence.

verified_gates.typed_lost_ack: nil RPC error and MutationUnknown; exactly one observed forwarded mutation, ACK and drop; independent n=1. MongoDB backend expression avoids transaction commit retry ambiguity.
verified_gates.search_version: Seed version1 and actual version=seed+1 for lost ACK and cancellation
verified_gates.proxy_ownership: Exact per-command/path unique ID match, serial observation offsets, finite frame/body sizes, real backend reply before ACK indication; no database stop/failpoint
verified_gates.same_sdk_recovery: Same suite.client reused; safe Read polling then APPLIED Put, read/direct oracle, APPLIED Delete, missing read/direct delete oracle, Native; explicit final wall-clock check against original5s deadline
verified_gates.same_pid: Initial Docker State.Pid compared after recovery for both backends
verified_gates.shutdown: SIGTERM after Mongo native real ACK then observer releases failed IO; explicit <=8s, exit0, OOM=false, independent n=1, observer sockets0; owner-checked fixture cleanup proves container absence
verified_gates.sdk_floor: Pinned weir-go v0.16.0 closes bootstrap and creates one business channel per Store; one SDK x2 Stores=2 connections; each store.IngressConnectionBytes=524288; total1048576

formal_run_requirements: Run only after sustained-load qualification ends, without overlapping injected faults or Go/build load.
Close F3, freeze a clean source commit, build the exact Linux arm64 CLI plus host race integration driver; preserve first result without retry/overwrite.
Set WEIR_PRODUCTION_FAULT_QUALIFICATION=1, WEIR_INTEGRATION=1, WEIR_SEARCH_INTEGRATION=elasticsearch; unset WEIR_MONGO_PROFILE and WEIR_FAULT_EXPLORATORY.
Set absolute WEIR_QUALIFICATION_BINARY, exact40-character WEIR_QUALIFICATION_SOURCE and matching WEIR_QUALIFICATION_SHA256.

Verify owned plaintext MongoDB8.0.32 replica set, Elasticsearch8.19.22, pinned BusyBox1.37.0 arm64 image, Linux aarch64 cgroupv2 Docker engine, and host.docker.internal reachability for owned host proxy listeners.
Run only TestProductionProcessFaultQualification with sufficient overall timeout; harness constructs512MiB/2CPU/default service policy.
Preserve raw logs/exit/source manifests, validate both backends plus shutdown with no exploratory/skip acceptance, and independently verify owned container/namespace absence.
